sources: http://www.riverbottomfarms.com/rates.html (with its '2026 Rate Schedule' table image, publishImages/rates~~element104.JPG)

values.note: Full hook-up sites have 30/50 amp, water and sewer; the Basic sites (pop-ups and tents only) have 20/30 amp and water.

hookups.source: http://www.riverbottomfarms.com/rates.html, 2026 Rate Schedule ('Full Hook-up 30/50amp: 30 & 50 amp site with water and sewer. Some pull-thru. Big rig friendly'; 'Basic: 20 & 30 amp sites with water. For pop-up and tents only'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 70+ large grassy sites: 52 full hook-up, 25 pull-through; Basic sites are for pop-ups and tents only and close December-February. One camping unit and at most 6 people per site.

sites.source: http://www.riverbottomfarms.com/amenities.html ('70 + large grassy sites, 25 pull-through, 52 full hook-up') + rates.html ('One camping unit per site'; 'Basic site closed Dec - Feb'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: http://www.riverbottomfarms.com/amenities.html ('Immaculate ADA bath house with hot showers'; 'Laundry facilities'; 'General store with RV supplies, bait & ice'; 'Dump station'; 'Free wireless Internet'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book by phone (803-568-4182) or the contact form; a non-refundable deposit ($25 for one night, $50 for 2-5) is charged at booking. Two-night minimum on weekends (the rates page says February 1-November 30, the reservations page April 1-November 30) and two to three nights for holidays and special events, which include every October weekend. Check-in 2-7 pm weekdays, 2-5 pm Sunday; check-out noon.

booking.source: http://www.riverbottomfarms.com/reservation.html ('To make a reservation, please call 803-568-4182'; deposits; '2 night minimum on all weekend stays April 1 until November 30'; check-in/out; 'Special Events and holidays include ... All Weekends in October') + rates.html ('Two night minimum on weekend stays from February 1 until November 30'; 'Two to three night minimum stay for holidays and special events'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026: full hook-up 30/50 amp $50 a night, $55 on holidays and event dates; weekly $300. Rates for 4 people, $5 per extra person a day; SC hospitality tax extra. The $45 Basic site is for pop-ups and tents only.

fees.source: http://www.riverbottomfarms.com/rates.html, 2026 Rate Schedule (Full Hook-up 30/50amp: Holiday & Event Rate $55.00, Daily Rate $50.00, Weekly $300.00; 'Rates based on 4 people per site'; 'Rates subject to South Carolina Hospitality tax'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Good Sam discount 24/7 with proof of membership; 10% off for seniors (65+), veterans and military, not on weekly or monthly rates.

discounts.source: http://www.riverbottomfarms.com/rates.html ('Good Sam's discount 24/7. Must have proof of membership to receive discount.'; '10% discount to all Senior Citizens (65 or older), Veterans, and Military personnel. Does not apply to monthly and weekly rates.'), read 2026-10-21

note: On 43 acres of farmland ~28 mi SW of Columbia, with stocked fishing ponds and nature trails down to Sleepy Creek and the North Edisto River; pool (early May-mid September) and playground. Welcomes snowbirds and monthly campers. --Claude
summary: Operator site (2026 rate table) gives $50 full hook-up 30/50A ($55 holidays), confirms 70 sites with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/store/dump/Wi-Fi, Good Sam and military discounts. Added fees, phone booking, weekend + holiday 2-night minimums. At exactly $50 the base is not over the gate (and Good Sam takes 10% off; Congaree NP gateway 39 km). Note trimmed. Not stated: season for RV sites, max rig length.
